description: Conformed union of the nflverse 2010-2025 lines extract and the ESPN 2026 schedule
operation: UNION (inputs are disjoint in time and in ESPN event id space; no row-level join occurs)
joinKey: espnEventId is indexed but NOT unique - never use it as a key

conformance.week: regular-season week ONLY; null for playoffs. Resolves the week-18 collision (RS wk18 in 2021+ vs Wild Card in 2010-2020).
conformance.playoffRound: WC/DIV/CON/SB; null for regular season. 2026 playoff weeks 1/2/3/5 map to WC/DIV/CON/SB (week 4 is the pre-Super-Bowl bye).
conformance.franchiseId: ESPN franchise id, stable across relocation. OAK->13, STL/LA->14, SD->24, WAS->28. The abbreviation is an era-specific label, never a key.
conformance.resultStatus: final (played, scores present) | scheduled (2026, teams known) | tbd (2026 playoff slot, matchup unresolved)

knownUpstreamDefects.detail: nflverse attaches this id to both 2010_10_HOU_JAX and 2010_10_SEA_ARI. Asserted by gate G17.
271 regular-season games, not 272: the 2023-01-02 Bills-Bengals game was abandoned and never resumed; nflverse omits the row.

gates: G01 row count is the exact sum of both inputs
G02 gameId unique (primary key)
G03 no unmapped team abbreviation (relocation crosswalk complete)
G04 every non-TBD game resolves to two known franchise ids
G05 no game has a team playing itself
G06 franchise id universe is exactly the 32 known teams
G07 week is populated iff REG (playoff week ambiguity removed)
G08 playoffRound is populated iff POST
G09 regular-season game count is era-correct every season
G10 playoff bracket size is correct every season
G11 result and total are arithmetically consistent with the scores
G12 scores present iff resultStatus is final
G13 no null in any required identity field
G14 every kickoffUtc parses as a UTC instant
G15 seasons are contiguous 2010-2026 with no gap
G16 every team plays the era-correct number of regular-season games
G17 espnEventId duplicates are exactly the one documented upstream defect
G18 every completed game carries a full set of lines and prices
G19 no 2026 row carries score or line data
G20 TBD games carry no franchise id (matchup genuinely unresolved)
